# Arena Partners

> Arena Partners provides outsourced operating partners to venture capital and growth investors. We embed with Series A–B portfolio companies whose revenue has stalled, develop the plan, execute it alongside the team, and leave behind a more capable, self-sufficient organization.

## What we do
- Work on behalf of funds, so partners don't have to shepherd struggling companies themselves and can focus on new deals.
- Embed at every level of the portfolio company, from the board and CEO down to individual contributors.
- Focus on one outcome: restoring revenue growth, so the company becomes another win for the fund.

## Who it's for
- Venture capital and growth investors with a Series A–B portfolio company whose revenue growth or traction is behind plan.
